title: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the National Commission
for Basic Education Ordinance, 1993.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
2. Definitions.‑In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Chairman" means the Chairman of the
Commission;
(b) "Secretary" means
the Secretary of the Commission;
(c) "Commission"
means the National Commission for Basic Education established under section 3;
(d) "member" means
members of the Commission; and
(e) "prescribed"
means prescribed by the rules made under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Establishment of the commission

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
3. Establishment of the Commission.‑(1) The
Federal Government shall, by notification in the official Gazette, establish a
Commission to be called by the National Commission for Basic Education.
(2) The Commission shall be a
body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with powers,
subject to the provisions of this Ordinance, to acquire, hold and dispose of
property, both movable and immovable, and shall by its name specified in
subsection (1) sue and be sued.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Composition of the commission

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
4. Composition of the Commission.‑(1) The
Commission shall consist of the following members, namely.‑‑
(a) the Chairman; and
(b) four members, one from each Province.
(2) The Chairman and the
members shall be appointed by the President from amongst eminent educationists,
administrators and persons engaged in the field of basic education and adult
literacy. .
(3) The four members referred
to. in clause (b) of subsection (1) shall .work on part‑time basis. .
(4) The Chairman and the
members shall hold office for a period of three years and shall be eligible for
re‑appointment.
(5) No act or proceedings of
the Commission shall be invalid by reasons only of the existence of a vacancy
in, or defect in the constitution of the Commission.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Resignation and filling of vacancies

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
5. Resignation and tilling of
vacancies: ‑‑(1) A member may, by writing under his hand addressed
to the President, resign his office.
(2) Any vacancy occurring in
the membership of the Commission due to death, resignation or removal of a
member shall be filled by the appointment of another person in accordance with
the provisions of section 4.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Powers and duties of chairman etc

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
6. Powers and duties of
Chairman, etc.‑(1) The Chairman shall be the principal executive officer
of the Commission and shall ensure that the provisions of this Ordinance and the
rules made thereunder are faithfully observed and for that purpose, exercise
such powers as may be necessary.
(2) The Chairman may‑‑‑
(a) appoint, punish or dismiss
an employee of the Commission as may be prescribed;
(b) create and fill temporary
posts for a period not exceeding six months; and
(c) exercise and perform such
other powers and duties as may be prescribed.
(3) The Chairman may, subject
to such conditions, if any, as may be prescribed, delegate any of his powers to
such officers and employees of the Commission as he may deem fit.
(4) The Chairman shall be
entitled to such salary, allowances and privileges as the Federal Government
may determine.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Secretary of the commission

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
7. Secretary of the Commission.‑(1) The
Secretary shall be a whole‑
time officer of the Commission and shall be appointed
by the Federal Government on such terms and conditions as it may determine and
shall act as ex‑officio member of the Commission.
(2) The Secretary shall be the
custodian of the records of the Commission and shall act as the coordinator of
administration under the general directions and supervision of the Chairman and
shall perform such other duties as may be assigned to him by the Chairman.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Functions of the commission

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
8. Functions of the Commission.‑‑(l)
The functions of the Commission shall be to‑‑‑
(a) organize and launch a
national campaign for the promotion of the adult literacy and primary education
to achieve universal literacy by the year 2000;
(b) assist and coordinate the
efforts of various public and private agencies engaged in basic education
programmes;,
(c) collaborate with national and international
agencies for resource mobilization and programme development;
(d) monitor and evaluate
existing local and foreign‑aided programmes in adult literacy and primary
education; and
(e) advise on any matter referred to it by the
Federal Government or Provincial Government relating to the universalization of
basic education.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Meeting of the commission

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
9. Meetings of the Commission.‑‑The
meetings of the Commission shall be held at such place, time and date as the
Chairman may determine.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Funds etc

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
10. Funds etc.‑(1) There shall be a fund of the
Commission in which shall be credited,‑‑
(a) grants from the Federal Government out of the
allocations to the basic education in the Social Action Programme Fund for the
year 1993‑94; and
(b) fifty per cent. of the Iqra surcharge collected
each year commencing from the first day of July, 1994.
(2) All expenditure incurred by the Commission shall
be met out of the funds specified in subsection (1).
(3) The accounts of the Commission shall be
maintained in such form and manner as may be specified by the Federal
Government and shall be audited by the Accountant‑General of Pakistan
Revenues.
(4) The Commission shall, at the end of every year,
submit a report of its activities in the field of basic education to Majfs‑e‑Shoora
(Parliament).

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Assistance of the commission

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
11. Assistance to the Commission.‑‑All
Ministries, Departments and other agencies engaged in the promotion of basic
education and adult literacy shall extend full cooperation and assistance to
the Commission in the performance of its functions.

sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Basic Education Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Rules

ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
ORDINANCE, XXXIV 1993
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR BASIC EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1993
12. Rules.‑The Commission may, with . the
approval of the Federal Government, by notification in the official Gazette,
make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
